name: Reliable Constrained Decoding for Diffusion LLMs under Context-Free Grammars
executive_summary: A lookahead-then-verify approach to enforcing context-free-grammar constraints reliably on diffusion-model output, addressing failure cases the more basic diffusion-constraint approach misses.
description: Complements the formal-syntax-for-diffusion line of work with a specifically reliability-focused method: rather than constraining each denoising step locally, it uses lookahead and post-hoc verification to catch cases where locally-valid steps still produce a globally invalid final sequence.
when_to_use: Diffusion-model structured generation where the basic per-step constraint approach has observed reliability gaps.
when_not_to_use: Autoregressive generation, or diffusion generation with looser reliability requirements.
known_pitfalls: Lookahead-then-verify adds computational overhead relative to purely local constraint enforcement.
